summary: Lets the customer send logs to the premium destinations (Splunk, Datadog, the cloud-only sinks).
tooltip: Turns on the destinations that need extra licensing or a paid integration on the receiving side — Splunk, Datadog, and similar enterprise-only systems. The standard destinations (files, common cloud storage, OpenTelemetry) work without this. If the customer asks 'can I send logs to Splunk?' this is the box that answers yes.
